about: The readiness evidence register: what was observed, when, at which commit, with what result, and the receipt that proves it. Bounded by `rules`; scripts/readiness_register.py archive moves what is stale or over the limit to evidence-archive.json with a reason, and never deletes. Not a tracker: open work is in the issues.

claims.claim: rest-mail.com serves the approved diagrams, readable at 1440px and 390px
claims.head: 0a8ec1b2ad4cb9f2228e52eff9948d3f36e1f247

claims.claim: Issue audit of 2026-11-03: scope and limits
claims.head: fd1db07402ac0e896bfaffa9d490296c59d80fcc
claims.result: Triage of 99 open issues against merged main at fd1db07402ac. Zero tests run. Twelve issues Cannot tell. Closed window October 4-November 3: 39 of 359 closed issues received a risk-focused source review, 320 did not.
claims.limits: Historical. Not an acceptance certificate, and no classification in it permits closing an issue.
claims.verbatim:
Read-only issue audit requested by the owner on November 3, 2026. Code baseline: detached, freshly fetched [origin/main at fd1db07402ac](https://github.com/rest-mail/rest-mail-server/commit/fd1db07402ac0e896bfaffa9d490296c59d80fcc), rechecked **2026-11-03 15:51:43 UTC**. Only merged main counts as implemented. The refreshed 99-open-issue inventory predates this tracking issue (94 initially, plus #1624/#1627/#1628/#1629/#1630 opened during the audit); 37 open PRs were separately listed and none counted as a merged fix.

**Important: this is triage, not an exhaustive acceptance certificate.** All 99 open issue bodies and all 288 comments were retrieved with pagination; claims/criteria/decisions were compared with main and relevant tests/history. Large inherited discussions were reviewed through criteria/status/decision extracts, not independently verified sentence by sentence. Twelve issues are explicitly Cannot tell, including the large contract umbrellas where complete inherited acceptance was not established. Do not use the other classifications as permission to close an issue without its remaining conditions.

Closed window: **October 4–November 3, 2026**. All 359 closed bodies, 326 comments and closing-event metadata were retrieved/screened; **39 received a risk-focused source review, 320 did not receive a per-criterion source audit**. The comments enumerate both sets and every unticked-checklist flag. Manual closes and partial-PR closures received special attention, but this is not all 195 completed issues certified.

**Verification performed: source, test definitions, merged history and issue/PR metadata read. Zero tests run; no load, whole suite, image build, Docker resource, real email or production operation.** Historical test receipts are attributed evidence, not runs performed by this audit. Separate mobile/website/provider/production acceptance is explicitly unverified. Existing issues (including all 22 claimed:homelab issues) were not edited, closed or reopened; no code or PR was created.

claims.limits: Counts as of 2026-11-03. The open issues have moved since.
